O: Whichever name he gets it from, O is the perfect blend of humour and good grace, of application and silliness, of compassion and composure. Need we say any more.
Oakley: I guess they could have named him Prada or Billabong - who knows? Either way Oakley is a little slow on the uptake, possibly because he gets distracted. If you know one you can do him a favour by calling him “O”. He’ll stand up straighter and react faster, and he’ll be far more adept at making critical decisions. The end.
Ocean: Ocean gets handed more joints than nearly anyone in the entire Kingdom such that he's nearly lost at sea. (Mate, we all need a breather from time to time.)
Ochre: Fickle? You better believe it. Then again, corporate strategic meetings, expensive silk ties and the correct shoes are categorically none of his fucking business, praise the lord. So, the fact that he’s never punctual, happy as a mountain goat and, in his youth, perpetually stoned means that he’s allowed to be a little unreliable in the real world. The Spiritual Seekers usually are, and whether they’re successful or not.
Ock: Man, how can one person be so slack yet get as much done as he does? Ever seen the movie Into The Wild? Well that bloke who vanished into the wilderness and who eventually died is just like Ock, except Ock's luck is much better, which means he never died. Indeed, if Ock tried that in attempt to find himself, he'd be found instead by three gorgeous female Norwegian trekkers with long legs and blonde hair down to their arses. Know what I mean? How does he do it?
Oden: Never rushed, Oden is the name of a Viking ship sailing the frigid waters of the North Sea. Well made, Oden deals with adversity very well. Indeed, he loves it.
Odysseus: When in doubt, Odysseus heads to the casino. Full stop.
Ohad: Peaceful on the outside. Domineering in the bedroom.
Olar: Rarely loud and ‘in your face’, Olar measures his words that are well-intended and wise. He’s a funny guy, and in past life he was a Great Fish Sage that lived in the Mekong River, in Vietnam.
Olav: A gentle, caring and giant-hearted man.
Oleh: Serious when it comes to the family name and moneys owed, Oleh is continually trying to find a way forward.
Oliver: Once we described Oliver is serious and sensitive, and someone who was in his element when it rained for days on end because it meant he didn’t have to leave the house. A little confession from the boys in the commentary box….we were just trying to get a rise out of him. Oliver is sensitive, that part is true enough, and sure, he’s serious when he needs to be, just, but Oliver is into life and he has a fun streak which runs through the middle of his entire being. You may not necessarily see it (although in the case of Oliver being the loudest and most extravagant personality in the room, you can’t miss it) but be rest assured that somewhere, somehow, perhaps in a social setting which you aren’t privy to yet, Oliver is the life of the gathering and people are disappointed if he doesn’t show up. Too right.
Ollie: Ollie is about 40cm tall, covered in brown fur, has little buttons for eyes and boys and girls talk to him after they go to bed. Which is to say, Ollie is reasonably adorable, he’s more peace-loving than just about anyone and his rather massive group of friends is testament to how funny and compassionate he is. What more can we say? If he ever elects to joint the army you are dealing with some kind of Ollie impostor, full stop.
Omar: He's a polite man who doesn't mind a bit of hard work. But, Omar, in case you're in the habit of denying them, and just to let you know, women are capable of doing every job as well as any man, and behaving the same way if she feels like it, as well. With that in mind, may peace be with you.
Onyx: Onyx, do you have the spark of genius? Is it in there? Are you capable of rising up when the chips are down?.....that, my boy, is the question and only you can answer it. (Note: at least they didn't call you basalt, or sandstone.)
Oren: Oren doesn't so much as blast into the room, he kind of slides in without people realising. Suddenly you turn around and there he is - Oren. You haven't seen him in ages and you've been looking forward to catching up because he's a good guy. And he's always full of surprises.
Oresto: Oresto is a loveable buffoon. He can't swim and he loves his food.
Ori: Like a gaseous nebula in the night sky, Ori gives the appearance of being quite calm and serene, but internally there are tempests raging. Your exposure to these storms depends on how close you get, I suppose. He’s not destined to be a leader of industry, but he may very well deliver a permaculture workshop.
Orion: As The Plastic Man, Orion is similar to Gwen in that he is something of a chameleon. Orion seems to be everywhere at once and capable of all myriad of deeds and thoughts, although only a chosen few will be privy to what they are…
Orpheus: When Orpheus is drunk at parties he likes to stand up on a seat and give a speech, and he thinks the movie Avatar was a fucking documentary.
Oscar: An outstanding personality from any angle. He has a thousand jokes and weird anecdotes up his sleeve and the numbers of many more mysterious women in his little black book. He hardly ever works and he gets invited to lots of parties.
Oskar: City dweller. Knows all the haunts. Good at taking the path of least resistance.
Otis: We can't say Otis is carved into refinement, but he does appear to be organised in his head. True, you might not think that after looking at his bedroom, but he's not as ambivalent about life matters as you would imagine. Projects: this is what Otis is into. He likes to plot his progress and give himself a framework in which to operate. He might even take a while to get to know well, but he'll be worth the journey.
Ou: (Pron. Oo-uh) Traditional and Turkish, Ou dances like an alien creature that has just discovered recreational drugs.
Owen: Owen is a round sound for a round fellow and for a well-rounded individual. He grows organic veggies when he can and a beard sometimes – the former in summer, the latter in winter – and he’s solid in long-term relationships, mostly because he knows who he is.
Oxlan: Oxlan will disobey a direct order if he deems it grossly unfair or cruel, but he’ll tolerate a fair bit until then. Once bitten he never forgets and once his trust is gone it’s gone for good.
